title: 水庫邊坡穩定監測~Reservoir-slope stability monitoring
focus: 整合庫水位降雨孔壓與三維位移判讀邊坡~Integrating reservoir stage rainfall pore pressure and three-dimensional slope displacement
summary: 本課以整合庫水位降雨孔壓與三維位移判讀邊坡為主線，先用有效應力與孔壓與無限邊坡力學示意界定水力與構造條件，再將衛星定位共同誤差、位移速率與加速度連結到監測不確定與應變。以合成邊坡作機制識別，無法由單一位移序列預測崩塌時間或湧浪。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。~This course develops integrating reservoir stage rainfall pore pressure and three-dimensional slope displacement through Effective stress and pore pressure and Infinite slope force illustration, then connects GNSS common-mode errors and Displacement rate and acceleration to Monitoring uncertainty and response. Synthetic slopes illustrate mechanisms; a single displacement series cannot predict failure time or impulse waves. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
history: 本課所研究的整合庫水位降雨孔壓與三維位移判讀邊坡，反映水工設計由單一尺寸選取走向水流、材料、施工與長期監測共同驗證的發展。以合成邊坡作機制識別，無法由單一位移序列預測崩塌時間或湧浪。 美國墾務局官方目錄列有1978年消能工專論、1980年水力試驗技術及1987年小壩設計，這些是技術文件出版年份，不是本課假想工程的啟用日期。所列具名工程只供公開原理與邊界比較，不主張取得其設計圖、現場紀錄或專有參數。~The focus on integrating reservoir stage rainfall pore pressure and three-dimensional slope displacement reflects development from isolated sizing toward joint verification of flow, materials, construction and long-term observations. Synthetic slopes illustrate mechanisms; a single displacement series cannot predict failure time or impulse waves. The Reclamation catalog lists the 1978 energy-dissipator monograph, 1980 hydraulic laboratory techniques and 1987 small-dam manual. These are publication dates, not commissioning dates for a hypothetical project. Named works support comparisons of public principles and boundaries; this course claims no access to proprietary drawings, field records or project parameters.
example: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查有效應力與孔壓：sigmaNormal=150 kPa; u=60 kPa; phi=30 degrees; friction=(150-60)*tan(30 degrees)=51.9615 kPa；再獨立檢查無限邊坡力學示意：Dry cohesionless slope: phi=32 degrees; beta=24 degrees; FS=tan(32 degrees)/tan(24 degrees)=1.40348。敏感度：相同總正應力150kPa下，孔壓由60增為90kPa，有效正應力由90降為60kPa；固定摩擦角30度時摩擦抗力由51.96降為34.64kPa，減少三分之一。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。以合成邊坡作機制識別，無法由單一位移序列預測崩塌時間或湧浪。 將對照庫水位與滑面孔壓下降量並檢查停降後是否繼續消散作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。~Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Effective stress and pore pressure: sigmaNormal=150 kPa; u=60 kPa; phi=30 degrees; friction=(150-60)*tan(30 degrees)=51.9615 kPa. Independently examine Infinite slope force illustration: Dry cohesionless slope: phi=32 degrees; beta=24 degrees; FS=tan(32 degrees)/tan(24 degrees)=1.40348. Sensitivity: at total normal stress150kPa, raising pore pressure from60 to90kPa reduces effective normal stress from90 to60kPa. With a fixed30-degree friction angle, frictional resistance decreases from51.96 to34.64kPa, a one-third reduction. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Synthetic slopes illustrate mechanisms; a single displacement series cannot predict failure time or impulse waves. Use the following independent check: Compare reservoir and slip-surface head reductions and observe continued dissipation during a hold. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.

units.anchor: 有效應力與孔壓~Effective stress and pore pressure
units.title: 有效應力與孔壓~Effective stress and pore pressure
units.mechanism: 水庫邊坡的抗剪能力受滑面有效正應力控制，外部水位下降可能移除坡腳水壓支撐，內部孔壓卻尚未消散。必須將坡內孔壓與滑面總應力分開估計，不能只用庫水位替代；簡化摩擦式也忽略了吸力、軟化與漸進破壞。 驗證時應將滑面附近孔壓時序與庫水位下降段對齊比較，並辨識以下失效情境：孔壓消散慢於外水位下降可降低有效抗剪能力。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Slope resistance depends on effective normal stress. Falling reservoir stage may remove external support before internal pressure dissipates. Estimate total stress and slip-surface pore pressure separately rather than replacing internal head with reservoir level; the simple friction law also omits suction, softening and progressive failure. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Align pore pressures near the potential slip surface with reservoir drawdown intervals. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Pore pressure lagging external drawdown can reduce available shear resistance. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：sigmaNormal=150 kPa; u=60 kPa; phi=30 degrees; friction=(150-60)*tan(30 degrees)=51.9615 kPa。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: sigmaNormal=150 kPa; u=60 kPa; phi=30 degrees; friction=(150-60)*tan(30 degrees)=51.9615 kPa. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.
units.verify: 將滑面附近孔壓時序與庫水位下降段對齊比較。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「孔壓消散慢於外水位下降可降低有效抗剪能力」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。~Align pore pressures near the potential slip surface with reservoir drawdown intervals. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Pore pressure lagging external drawdown can reduce available shear resistance. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.
units.failure: 孔壓消散慢於外水位下降可降低有效抗剪能力。診斷時應採取以下查核：將滑面附近孔壓時序與庫水位下降段對齊比較，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。~Pore pressure lagging external drawdown can reduce available shear resistance. Diagnose it by the following check: Align pore pressures near the potential slip surface with reservoir drawdown intervals. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.
units.misconception: 庫水位降低就保證坡內孔壓同時降低~Falling reservoir stage guarantees simultaneous internal pore-pressure reduction
units.practice: 交接時以將滑面附近孔壓時序與庫水位下降段對齊比較作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對孔壓消散慢於外水位下降可降低有效抗剪能力，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。~At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Align pore pressures near the potential slip surface with reservoir drawdown intervals. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Pore pressure lagging external drawdown can reduce available shear resistance. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

units.anchor: 無限邊坡力學示意~Infinite slope force illustration
units.title: 無限邊坡力學示意~Infinite slope force illustration
units.mechanism: 均勻無限邊坡把重量分解為沿坡驅動與垂直坡面的正力，適合展示厚度、坡角與孔壓的作用，不能代表複雜旋轉滑動。所用深度須明定為垂直深度，否則三角函數形式不同；有側向約束與分層時應改用合適的分析模型。 驗證時應以剖面地形確認平行滑面假設並對摩擦角做獨立試驗，並辨識以下失效情境：把乾燥簡式套在高孔壓層會高估抗滑比。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~An infinite-slope idealization resolves weight into driving and normal components, illustrating depth, angle and pore-pressure effects without representing rotational slides. Specify vertical depth because slope-normal thickness produces different geometry. Lateral confinement, layering and curved slip surfaces require a different analysis rather than hidden adjustments to this equation. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check the parallel-plane assumption against cross-sections and test friction angle independently. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using the dry expression in a high-pressure layer overstates resistance. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Dry cohesionless slope: phi=32 degrees; beta=24 degrees; FS=tan(32 degrees)/tan(24 degrees)=1.40348。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: Dry cohesionless slope: phi=32 degrees; beta=24 degrees; FS=tan(32 degrees)/tan(24 degrees)=1.40348. units.anchor: 水文傳遞時間尺度~Hydrological diffusion time scale
units.title: 水文傳遞時間尺度~Hydrological diffusion time scale
units.mechanism: 降雨與庫水位會透過不同通道影響孔壓，擴散時間約隨距離平方增加，因此深層反應可能晚於地表事件。特徵時間只給量級，裂縫對流、非飽和入滲與變動邊界均會偏離均質擴散；應用多深度觀測區分傳遞機制。 驗證時應比較不同深度孔壓峰值時差並保留降雨強度與庫水位紀錄，並辨識以下失效情境：把相關時差直接當因果證明可能漏掉共同季節驅動。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Rainfall and reservoir stage influence pressures through different pathways. A diffusion time scale grows with distance squared, so deep response may lag surface forcing. This is an order-of-magnitude estimate; fracture advection, unsaturated infiltration and moving boundaries depart from uniform diffusion and require observations at several depths. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare pressure-peak delays by depth alongside rainfall intensity and reservoir-stage records. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Treating correlation lag as causation can overlook a common seasonal driver. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：LengthScale=20 m; hydraulicDiffusivity=0.002 m2/s; characteristicTime=20**2/0.002/86400=2.31481 days。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: LengthScale=20 m; hydraulicDiffusivity=0.002 m2/s; characteristicTime=20**2/0.002/86400=2.31481 days. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

units.anchor: 測斜積分與基準~Inclinometer integration and reference
units.title: 測斜積分與基準~Inclinometer integration and reference
units.mechanism: 測斜儀以各段傾角積分得到水平位移，底端固定假設與套管方向是必要邊界。局部剪切會集中在少數深度，而整根套管轉動可能呈現平滑曲線；需要反向讀值與穩定基準，不能把積分結果一律解釋成滑面位移。 驗證時應核對正反向探測閉合及底端穩定性並檢查位移集中深度，並辨識以下失效情境：底端隨滑體移動會低估整體平移量。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~An inclinometer integrates segment inclinations into lateral displacement. A fixed toe and known casing orientation are essential boundaries. Local shear concentrates at limited depths, whereas rotation of the whole casing may produce a smooth curve; opposite-face readings and an independent stable reference distinguish these mechanisms. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check opposite-face consistency and toe stability, then identify depths of concentrated displacement. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A toe moving with the slide underestimates bulk translation. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Ten identical segments: segmentLength=0.50 m; angleChange=0.20 degrees; lateralChange=10*0.50*sin(0.20 degrees)=0.0174533 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: Ten identical segments: segmentLength=0.50 m; angleChange=0.20 degrees; lateralChange=10*0.50*sin(0.20 degrees)=0.0174533 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

units.anchor: 衛星定位共同誤差~GNSS common-mode errors
units.title: 衛星定位共同誤差~GNSS common-mode errors
units.mechanism: 衛星定位能量測表面三維位移，但參考站漂移與共同大氣誤差會投影到所有測點。相對位移有助辨認坡體內部變形，卻可能消去真實共同平移；應同時保留絕對與相對解，並以坡外穩定點驗證參考框架。 驗證時應將坡外基準站與坡內測點的共同訊號和相對變形分別繪圖，並辨識以下失效情境：移動的參考站會使整坡出現假性反向位移。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~GNSS provides three-dimensional surface displacement, but reference-station drift and shared atmospheric errors affect many points together. Relative motion helps reveal internal deformation yet can remove genuine common translation. Preserve absolute and relative solutions and test the reference frame using stable off-slope monuments. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Plot shared signals and relative deformation separately using off-slope reference stations. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A moving reference station creates an apparent opposite movement across the slope. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：PointA=18 mm; pointB=11 mm in same axis and epoch; relativeMotion=18-11=7 mm。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: PointA=18 mm; pointB=11 mm in same axis and epoch; relativeMotion=18-11=7 mm. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: A moving reference station creates an apparent opposite movement across the slope. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

units.anchor: 雷達視線投影~Radar line-of-sight projection
units.title: 雷達視線投影~Radar line-of-sight projection

Recover magnitude from a projection angle only when motion direction is independently known. Vegetation decorrelation, atmospheric delay and phase-unwrapping errors require ground-based checks before interpreting a trend. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare projections from different satellite tracks with three-dimensional ground positioning. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Near-perpendicular viewing greatly amplifies noise in recovered movement magnitude. units.anchor: 位移速率與加速度~Displacement rate and acceleration
units.title: 位移速率與加速度~Displacement rate and acceleration
units.mechanism: 差分位移可以揭露速率變化，卻同時放大量測雜訊；採樣間隔改變也會造成表觀加速。應使用相同時間窗與誤差模型，不把短期兩點差分外推成失穩日期；若降雨、溫度或施工改變，需分段解釋驅動條件。 驗證時應以相同時間窗重算速度並確認加速也出現在獨立測點，並辨識以下失效情境：不等間隔差分未除以時間會產生假的加速度。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Differencing displacement reveals rate changes but also amplifies noise. Changing observation intervals can create apparent acceleration. Use consistent windows and an uncertainty model rather than extrapolating two points into a failure date; interpret separate periods when rainfall, temperature or construction alters the driving conditions. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Recalculate rates over common windows and confirm acceleration at independent points. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Unequal-interval differences without time normalization generate false acceleration. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 水位降速與內水頭~Drawdown rate and internal head
units.title: 水位降速與內水頭~Drawdown rate and internal head
units.mechanism: 水庫調降速度與坡體排水速度不匹配時，外部支撐及內部有效應力會同時改變。以平均日降幅描述調度不代表孔壓已達平衡；需要把停降段與持續降段分開，並比較滑面附近與坡腳測點的不同反應。 驗證時應對照庫水位與滑面孔壓下降量並檢查停降後是否繼續消散，並辨識以下失效情境：把庫水位當全坡內水頭會忽略快速洩降的不利滯後。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~When drawdown outpaces slope drainage, external support and internal effective stress change differently. Mean daily drawdown does not establish pressure equilibrium. Separate holding periods from continued lowering and compare observations near the potential slip surface with those at the toe to identify spatially different responses. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare reservoir and slip-surface head reductions and observe continued dissipation during a hold. units.anchor: 潛在滑體與影響範圍~Potential slide volume and consequences
units.title: 潛在滑體與影響範圍~Potential slide volume and consequences
units.mechanism: 滑體幾何是後果分析的起點，但體積本身不能決定湧浪高度；入水速度、深度、滑體形狀與水庫幾何也重要。用簡化稜柱估體積應清楚標示平均厚度假設，再以地質界面、地形與鑽探檢驗範圍，避免把包絡體積當精確崩塌量。 驗證時應用鑽孔與地表裂縫約束滑面深度並對厚度範圍做敏感度，並辨識以下失效情境：把最大厚度套用整個面積會系統高估稜柱體積。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Slide geometry begins consequence assessment, but volume alone does not determine wave height. Entry velocity, depth, shape and reservoir geometry also matter. A prism estimate must state its average-thickness assumption and be checked against geology, terrain and boreholes rather than presented as an exact failure volume. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Constrain slip depth with boreholes and surface cracks and vary the thickness range. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Applying maximum thickness over the entire area systematically overestimates prism volume. units.anchor: 監測不確定與應變~Monitoring uncertainty and response
units.title: 監測不確定與應變~Monitoring uncertainty and response
units.mechanism: 儀器雜訊、基準誤差與空間代表性共同影響警戒解釋；兩個獨立時點差值的誤差不是單次精度。以合成標準不確定度可判斷訊號相對雜訊，但工程應變還需失效模式、資料可用率與既定責任鏈，不能僅依統計倍數自動停工。 驗證時應將共同基準偏差另列並以演練檢查警報到現場回報的流程，並辨識以下失效情境：沒有現場回報閉環的警報可能持續失去實際處置。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Noise, reference errors and spatial representativeness influence alerts. The uncertainty of a difference between independent epochs is not one-epoch precision. Combined standard uncertainty describes signal relative to noise, while response also depends on failure modes, data availability and assigned responsibilities rather than an automatic statistical multiplier. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Separate shared reference bias and exercise the process from alarm to field confirmation. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: An alarm without field-confirmation feedback can remain disconnected from action. sources.title: 美國墾務局水工手冊與專論目錄
sources.scope: 官方目錄核實 1978 消能工專論、1980 水力試驗技術、1987 小壩設計及1990氣蝕專論；目錄日期不是工程啟用年。
sources.scopeEn: Official catalog verifies the 1978 dissipator monograph, 1980 laboratory techniques, 1987 small-dam manual and 1990 cavitation monograph; publication dates are not project commissioning dates.

sources.title: 土石壩靜力穩定分析標準
sources.scope: 2011年章節提供穩定與水位工況脈絡，並非本課合成邊坡的地層資料。
sources.scopeEn: The 2011 chapter supplies stability and reservoir-stage context, not ground data for the synthetic slopes.

sources.title: 土石壩儀器與監測設計標準
sources.scope: 已讀2014年章節與滲流、孔壓、變形及潛在失效模式監測架構；教學數值另行假設。
sources.scopeEn: Read the 2014 chapter framework for seepage, pore pressure, deformation and potential-failure-mode monitoring; numerical lessons are separately assumed.

sources.title: USGS 邊坡監測科學計畫
sources.scope: 官方說明持續觀測邊坡與觸發機制研究；研究站資料不是本課案例量測。
sources.scopeEn: Official overview describes sustained landslide observation and trigger research; station data are not measurements for these teaching cases.

sources.title: USGS 郭卜水庫邊坡水文控制研究
sources.scope: 原始研究記錄拉西瓦郭卜邊坡由庫水位轉為降雨相關的變形；僅比較監測解釋，不借用論文參數作設計。
sources.scopeEn: Original research documents changing level and rainfall associations at Guobu beside Laxiwa; used to compare monitoring interpretations, not as design parameters.
